crossRefs.note: But that you also may know my affairs, how I am doing, Tychicus, the beloved brother and faithful servant in the Lord…
These accompanied him as far as Asia: Sopater of Beroea; Aristarchus and Secundus of the Thessalonians; Gaius of Derbe…
But I sent Tychicus to Ephesus.
When I send Artemas to you, or Tychicus, be diligent to come to me to Nicopolis, for I have determined to winter there.
together with Onesimus, the faithful and beloved brother, who is one of you. They will make known to you everything…
Epaphras, who is one of you, a servant of Christ, salutes you, always striving for you in his prayers, that you may…
But that you also may know my affairs, how I am doing, Tychicus, the beloved brother and faithful servant in the Lord…
But I counted it necessary to send to you Epaphroditus, my brother, fellow worker, fellow soldier, and your apostle and…
So let a man think of us as Christ’s servants, and stewards of God’s mysteries.

people.name: Tychicus
people.line: Faithful companion and messenger of Paul

translations.web: All my affairs will be made known to you by Tychicus, the beloved brother, faithful servant, and fellow bondservant in the Lord.
translations.bsb: Tychicus will tell you all the news about me. He is a beloved brother, a faithful minister, and a fellow servant in the Lord.
translations.kjv: All my state shall Tychicus declare unto you, who is a beloved brother, and a faithful minister and fellowservant in the Lord:
translations.asv: All my affairs shall Tychicus make known unto you, the beloved brother and faithful minister and fellow-servant in the Lord:
